goal:
For a lecture on the history of official statistics I'm using the UK Statistics Authority's timeline of the UK statistical system: https://www.statisticsauthority.gov.uk/archive/about-the-authority/uk-statistical-system/history/timeline.html
In which year did the Births and Deaths Registration Act receive Royal Assent? Please tell me where you found it.

paragraphs: 1801: First regular population census for Great Britain held
1836: The Births and Deaths Registration Act and the Marriage Act received Royal Assent, thereby establishing secular system for recording births, marriages and deaths.
1837: General Register Office (GRO) for England and Wales established

Independent oversight of the UK statistical system 
The UK Statistics Authority oversees the UK statistical system as a whole. It includes the Office for National Statistics and the Office for Statistics Regulation. 
 Learn about the UK Statistics Authority 
 How the UK statistics system works 
 UK Statistics Authority 
 The UK Statistics Authority is an independent statutory body, established in 2008 to safeguard the production and publication of official statistics that serve the public good.
